name: Define nf-watch component for pi
summary: Allows pi users to watch the nf task system when using pi

rawActions.name: Phase 1: Implement NfService and data models
rawActions.summary: Implement the data layer including NfTask interfaces, NfService for polling nf CLI, and error handling.

rawActions.name: Phase 2: Refactor WatchComponent for Reactive UI
rawActions.summary: Refactor component to use NfService, implement reactive rendering via invalidate(), and add ANSI styling.

rawActions.name: Phase 3: Infrastructure & Lifecycle Management
rawActions.summary: Implement proper cleanup (intervals, processes) and terminal resize support (SIGWINCH).

rawActions.name: Phase 4: Validation & Testing
rawActions.summary: Implement unit tests for NfService and an integration demo of the polished component.
